title: 新质生产力与“人工智能+”政策时间线
title_en: Timeline of new quality productive forces and “AI Plus” policy

records.title: “东数西算”全面启动
records.title_en: East Data, West Computing launched in full
records.detail: 8 个国家算力枢纽节点和 10 个国家数据中心集群完成批复，“东数西算”工程正式全面启动。
records.detail_en: Approval of 8 national computing hubs and 10 national data-centre clusters was completed, and the East Data, West Computing project was formally launched in full.

records.title: 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》公布
records.title_en: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services published
records.detail: 2023 年 7 月 10 日公布，8 月 15 日起施行。
records.detail_en: Published on 10 July 2023; in force from 15 August.

records.title: 首次提出“新质生产力”
records.title_en: “New quality productive forces” proposed for the first time
records.detail: 习近平总书记在黑龙江考察期间首次提出“新质生产力”（新时代推动东北全面振兴座谈会；听取黑龙江省委和省政府工作汇报）。
records.detail_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping first put forward “new quality productive forces” during an inspection tour of Heilongjiang (at a symposium on promoting the full revitalisation of Northeast China in the new era, and while hearing work reports from the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee and Provincial Government).

records.title: 《算力基础设施高质量发展行动计划》
records.title_en: Action Plan for the High-Quality Development of Computing Infrastructure
records.detail: 提出到 2025 年算力规模超过 300 EFLOPS，智能算力占比达到 35%。
records.detail_en: Set 2025 targets of more than 300 EFLOPS in total computing power, with AI computing power making up 35%.

records.title: 中央经济工作会议
records.detail: 提出“以颠覆性技术和前沿技术催生新产业、新模式、新动能，发展新质生产力”。
records.detail_en: Called for “using disruptive and frontier technologies to spawn new industries, new models and new growth drivers, and developing new quality productive forces”.

records.title: 中央政治局第十一次集体学习
records.title_en: 11th group study session of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau
records.detail: 首次系统阐释新质生产力内涵：“创新起主导作用……以劳动者、劳动资料、劳动对象及其优化组合的跃升为基本内涵，以全要素生产率大幅提升为核心标志”。
records.detail_en: First systematic explanation of new quality productive forces: “innovation plays the leading role … its basic connotation is the leap in workers, means of labour, objects of labour and their optimal combination, and its core hallmark is a substantial increase in total factor productivity”.

records.title: 政府工作报告提出“人工智能+”
records.detail: 政府工作报告首次提出“人工智能+”行动。
records.detail_en: The Government Work Report proposed the “AI Plus” initiative for the first time.

records.title: 19 个新职业、28 个新工种
records.detail: 人社部发布生成式人工智能系统应用员等 19 个新职业、28 个新工种。
records.detail_en: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security announced 19 new occupations, including generative AI system application specialist, and 28 new job types.

records.title: “人工智能+”行动意见（国发〔2025〕11号）
records.title_en: Opinions on the “AI Plus” initiative (Guo Fa [2025] No. 11)
records.detail: 8 月 21 日印发、8 月 26 日公布《国务院关于深入实施“人工智能+”行动的意见》。
records.detail_en: The State Council's Opinions on Deepening the Implementation of the “AI Plus” Initiative were issued on 21 August and published on 26 August.

records.title: “十五五”规划与机器人
records.detail: IFR 指出“十五五”规划（2026–2030）把机器人置于现代产业体系核心。
records.detail_en: The IFR notes that the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030) places robotics at the heart of the modern industrial system.

notes: date_precision 为 month/year 的事件只确定到月/年，绘图时取该月/年内的占位日，卡片中只显示到月/年。
notes_en: Events whose date_precision is month/year are known only to the month/year; they are plotted on a placeholder day within that month/year, and cards show only the month/year.
